Keys are model ids exactly as Token Factory's API lists them (ids from the official Token Factory cookbook; the id in NEBIUS_MODEL is confirmed in S7 with GET /v1/models and must appear here or the guard refuses). Prices read from the Nebius console prices page (tokenfactory.nebius.com/organization/prices, region eu-north1, filter 'Nemotron') on 2026-10-27 19:2x CDT. The console also lists a cheaper 'Cached' input price (valid from 20 Oct 2026); the wall charges every input token at the full input price, so it over-counts, never under-counts. Ultra is deliberately absent: never used.
